# 886 Studios

> 886 Studios is a Taipei-based venture firm that runs 886 Launchpad, a startup accelerator helping early-stage founders build global technology companies.

Canonical website: https://www.886studios.com/

## Programs

- [886 Launchpad](https://www.886studios.com/launchpad): A 10-week, in-person startup accelerator in Taipei with $100K USD in funding, weekly mentor office hours, workshops, investor introductions, and founder community support.
- [886 Residency](https://www.886studios.com/residency): An invite-only, 90-day community program for full-time founders and builders in Taipei, with free dedicated desks at Taiwan Tech Arena and active community participation.

## Organization

- [About 886 Studios](https://www.886studios.com/about): The operating team, partners, organizational background, and links to official profiles.
- [Portfolio](https://www.886studios.com/portfolio): Companies backed by 886 Studios and companies backed by 886 Studios partners.
- [Events](https://www.886studios.com/events): Current and past founder meetups, workshops, demo days, and community events.
- [Contact](https://www.886studios.com/contact): Contact options for founders, partners, and community members.

## Founder resources

- [Burn rate and runway guide](https://www.886studios.com/resources/burn-rate-runway-guide): Definitions, formulas, a hypothetical Taiwan startup example, and a cash-planning checklist for bootstrapped founders.
- [Resource library](https://www.886studios.com/resources): Guides covering accelerator applications, incorporation, interviews, fundraising, and the Taiwan startup ecosystem.
- [Application guide](https://www.886studios.com/resources/application-guide): Preparation guidance for startup accelerator applications.
- [Y Combinator (YC) application guide](https://www.886studios.com/resources/y-combinator-101): A founder-focused guide to YC applications, interviews, and accelerator preparation.
- [Interview guidebook](https://www.886studios.com/interview-guidebook): How 886 Studios program interviews work and how founders can prepare.
- [Taiwan ecosystem database](https://www.886studios.com/resources/ecosystem-database): A directory of startup ecosystem organizations and services in Taiwan.
